freshness: Each attempt is a separate Python process and constructs a fresh in-process MCP server, owner, producer, temporary directory, action ID, operation ID, recovery receipt, effect row, and oracle attempt.
pass_rule: A sample passes only when the exact focused unittest exits 0 and prints OK. Any nonzero/timeout/error is a failed attempt and remains in the denominator; no retry or replacement sample.
expected_invariants: source action remains unknown and its task_success remains null
recovery separately confirms release and matching late-input horizon
independent oracle scores only exact operation and target generation
scope: Fake/local public-MCP recovery lifecycle repeatability only
not_tested: live GUI or native Win32 input
prior_capture_failure: R03 aborted because the log directory was not created. Its unknown attempts are not scored or included in this R04 denominator.
